topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: I've been watching, you know. Seen the way they whisper behind closed doors, the way the light shines brighter in their windows than it ever does in mine. They think we don’t notice, the carefully hidden luxuries, the late-night arrivals of silent, sleek vehicles. But we see. We see the laughter that carries too easily on the wind, the shadows of wealth they can’t quite hide. It’s a game, playing the poor neighbor, isn’t it? But the game’s up, and now, well, now the truth slips out, unwanted, into the open. It sits there, between us, heavy and unspoken, changing things. It changes everything.
